# GitHub Milestone Template

Use this body when creating a milestone that represents a spec or deliverable in the agentic delivery flow.

```md
## Summary

Describe the deliverable and why it matters.

## Canonical Spec

- Repo spec link:

## Success Criteria

- Outcome 1
- Outcome 2

## Scope Notes

- Included:
- Excluded:

## Risks

- Key delivery or technical risks

## Exit Rule

Close this milestone only when all required issues are done or explicitly deferred with rationale.
```

## Usage Notes

- One milestone should represent one spec or deliverable.
- The canonical implementation detail should live in the repository spec, not only in the milestone.
- Link the spec in the milestone body.
- Attach every execution issue for that deliverable to the milestone.
- If work is intentionally deferred, capture the rationale before closing the milestone.
